sections.description: Royal BatchMate is a complete community, membership directory, reunion, and event management platform for WordPress. Built for SSC, HSC, and University alumni batches.
sections.changelog:
• 26.11.15: Fixed Guest Options (Family/Guest fees) not showing on Direct Form (Option 4) due to race condition. Removed duplicate Labels card from Registration Settings.
  • 26.11.14: English labels for event registration modal, auto-updater UTF-8 BOM resilience, and cache busting fixes.
  • 26.11.13: Added Option 4 (Direct Form Only) to Edit Event modal to bypass profile search and display full membership & event registration form upfront with photo upload. Added custom form title / button label support and auto-sync member profile photo and details on approval.
  • 26.11.12: Fixed activation 3 characters unexpected output (UTF-8 BOM removal). Fixed Event CC Email delivery on registration submissions, approval confirmations, and card resends with multi-address support. Updated default payment accounts to bKash 01552333272 Royal and bKash 01973245450 Mehdi.
  • 26.11.11: Added dedicated Elementor Event Form Widget with live style customization.
  • 26.11.10: Event registration live search optimization and debounce performance improvements.
  • 26.11.01: Executive Committee and financial collection report improvements.
